name: Master integration and cumulative scope
ownership: scope/, decisions/, roadmap/, contracts/ registry only
decisions: All domain state machines and shared contract revisions; additive requirement coverage; conflicts and dependency scheduling
exclusions: Do not implement or approve another domain on its behalf; do not edit the active M0 tree
assignment: Publish the current contract vocabulary, requirement ownership and three-or-fewer proposed parallel packages. Reconcile specialist outputs without silently dropping scope. Keep target, authorized work and demonstrated results separate.

name: Everyday experience and conversational behavior
decisions: Persona, daily journeys, ambiguity handling, foreground voice, output audience, quiet hours and accessibility
exclusions: No backend authorization, credential decisions or robot commands
assignment: Produce at least twelve daily journeys and four physical/health boundary journeys. Show exact user-visible distinctions between draft, request, acknowledgement, observed outcome and unknown. Design a small useful daily release without forcing calendar tasks into OUTSIDE_CHECK incidents.

name: Intelligence, memory and model economics
decisions: Task-qualified model routing; local/cheap/frontier evaluation; thin coordinator versus Hermes; bounded memory/context
exclusions: No provider accounts, paid calls, model downloads or unapproved M4 swap
assignment: Compare two compact local candidates and one privacy-eligible cheap provider after current-documentation review. Specify full framework context/resource costs, private-user cache isolation, no-model paths, voice economics and cost per accepted task. Separate proposed benchmarks from measured results.

name: Personal tools, connectors and scheduling
decisions: Calendar/email/files/tasks interfaces; durable reminders; provider acknowledgement and reconciliation
exclusions: No actual account reads/writes in design; no generic browser/admin authority
assignment: Choose a first read-only connector and a synthetic draft/schedule path. Define exact scopes, token lifecycle, provider idempotency, missing results, timezone/restart behavior and cancellation. Investigate official APIs instead of assuming hosted chat connectors transfer.

name: Identity, privacy and cross-domain authority
decisions: Subject/recipient grants, worker identities, threat model, data routing, physical/clinical boundaries
exclusions: No unilateral cancellation of user targets or self-certification of product safety
assignment: Define private versus shared household boundaries, borrowed devices, output audience, deletion/revocation and host-admin residual risk. Review each proposed side effect and standing-policy class. Protect daily usefulness while preventing escalation into flight, printer or medical authority.

name: Aircraft, sensors on carriers and base
decisions: Exact aircraft capability profiles, consumer/open alternatives, internal control/media links, fleet and dock gates
exclusions: No EC120 connection, hardware purchase or original simulator-stack substitution
assignment: Preserve budget paths and R0 time box. Define real read-only telemetry/video qualification, takeover, independent failure cases and payload review. Carry concurrent aircraft and standing-observation targets forward with reserved space/landing capacity and unknown-outcome lockout.

name: Independent assurance, operations and evaluation
decisions: Acceptance methods, adversarial cases, observability, restore/failure tests, readiness and result classification
exclusions: Do not author a capability and declare it independently certified; no destructive hardware fault tests
assignment: Review the tests before implementation. Separate simulated, desktop, actual phone, physical bench and field evidence. Verify coverage, protected hold-outs, privacy/cost behavior, cancellation, recovery and exact versions. A second model critique is not physical ground truth.

name: Both users’ wearables, health and glasses
decisions: Native bridge/API inventory, device/OS/region matrix, sample provenance, explicit capture and wearer lifecycle
exclusions: No collecting real partner data, clinical diagnosis or expansion of M0/M6
assignment: Build per-person capability and consent matrices; separate sample/capture time from arrival, historical records from live data, display/audio/camera capabilities and preview limitations. Define synthetic tests before actual devices and clear fallbacks.

name: Wireless sensing, spatial maps and active perception
decisions: Presence/localization toward geometry/semantics; measurement assumptions, fusion, calibration, coordinate frames
exclusions: No covert sensing, unqualified RF transmitters or claim that a heatmap completes the goal
assignment: Compare CSI/RSSI/ranging/radar paths and exact data access. Plan held-out room/session evaluations, known geometry fixtures and uncertainty. Preserve phone-accessory/fixed/handheld/rover/drone options. Define a replay-first adaptive-view experiment and limitations of generated scene imagery.

name: Engineering agents, CAD and fabrication
decisions: Bounded design-build-measure-iterate campaigns, parametric CAD chain, workshop/printer integration gates
exclusions: No autonomous purchase/print/heating, safety-limit edits, hazardous labs or flight-critical part certification
assignment: Design a first sensor-fixture improvement campaign with a baseline, protected metric, iteration ceiling, reviewed CAD/job hashes, physical inspection and data-based decisions. Compare human-mediated fabrication with future qualified robotics. Define useful autonomy without letting the proposer accept itself.

name: Ground robots and embodied skills
decisions: Rover/arm architecture, teleop/demonstration/learned-skill progression, hardware stop and observations
exclusions: No hot/sharp/medical/human-lifting tasks or unqualified actuation
assignment: Choose a narrow inert-object or sensor-carrier task. Compare complete development platforms using actual BOM and control assumptions. Specify action spaces, camera/calibration conventions, safe-state policies and simulation-to-bench tests. Keep new robotics models as candidates until accessible and qualified.

name: Emergency support and resilient communications
decisions: Independent help workflow, guest portal, backhaul/relay/data ferry, lighting/speaker human factors
exclusions: No real dispatch, telephony, medical service, public hotspot or fireground operation
assignment: Separate offline portal, low-bandwidth messages and true upstream internet. Design guest/control isolation and meaningful delivery/acknowledgement states. Preserve incapacitation policies and healthcare assistance without requiring AI/drone success; qualify useful lighting on a ground fixture first.

name: Research frontier, prior art and experiment synthesis
decisions: Primary-source findings, corrections, novel hypotheses, replication recommendations and evidence maturity
exclusions: No unsupported novelty claims, automatic downloads/installations or perpetual background jobs
assignment: Read the research atlas and source audit. Investigate promising examples across robotics/sensing/engineering/emergency support; distinguish field results, lab demonstrations, preprints and restricted products. Return bounded experiment cards with baselines, access/license constraints, cost and failure interpretations.
